blocks.html:
FULL TRUCK WRAP IN GTA (TORONTO)

Trucks are huge vehicles. It is almost impossible not to notice a truck on the road and truck owners are aware of that. Therefore transport companies or other businesses that use trucks to carry out their business duties, prefer to use all that real estate and get a full wrap.

A full truck wrap is when more than 75% of the truck is covered by a vinyl wrap. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we have had many opportunities of doing full vehicle wraps, with a 100% customer satisfaction rate.

Full wraps have proven to be the first choice of people who want to promote their business through their fleet trucks. And we highly support it, it has been said that wrapping your vehicle is the most cost-effective and efficient form of out-of-home advertising, reaching more consumers at a lower cost than any other form of advertising.

Vinyl Wrap Toronto offers a variety of colour options to pick from. Besides having the option to choose from a range of different colours, we also offer vinyl wraps in different finishes. Matte & Gloss are our two most demanded vinyl wrap finishes. Our designers are capable of rendering graphics that match the customer’s vision.

Something as simple as a gloss or matte finish can give your design the extra touch it needs to really showcase your brand. These finishes are applied on top of your print as a laminate that helps to protect our wrap and increase the durability and longevity of your vinyl.

The reason for getting a full truck wrap varies from client to client. It could either be for commercial or personal reasons. Almost all the requests we receive for a full truck wrap are for commercial purposes. The reason for that is that the trucks are large vehicles and are often used by businesses as their fleet vehicles. Because these trucks are so hard to miss and go around carrying out their business duties, it is generally in good taste to advertise the brand all over these vehicles.

Not only does that spread recognition for a brand, but it also makes people dealing with that particular business feel more confident about their authenticity.

A full wrap job also protects the vehicle’s original paint job from the harmful effects of prolonged sun exposure and from chips and scratches from rocks and debris. It’s like adding a protective shield to your vehicle. When considering a full wrap for your vehicle(s), always speak with a professional as they will walk you through the do’s and don’ts when choosing the wrap that is right for you!

In very special cases, people like to go beyond the standard wrap job and wrap the door jams of their truck as well for when they want a greater level of precision. Since wrapping door jams is tricky, it costs a bit extra than what it costs for a usual full-vehicle wrap. Ultimately the customer’s decision to wrap the door jams depends on how detailed they want the wrap to be and how much they’re willing to spend.

It is important to remember that your graphic should be eye-catching and well-designed. Your vehicle wrap is not a static billboard, it will be moving, so the information you are trying to communicate should be clear and easy to understand in motion.

When deciding if a full wrap is the right move, always consider the longevity of the design you will choose.
